title: A satisfied term gives a positive term count
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$, and let $x$ be an input in that cube. If a term $T$ of $\varphi$ is satisfied by $x$, then the number of terms of $\varphi$ satisfied by $x$ is at least $1$.
